description: This file defines the feature for creating a new user in an ASP.NET Core application, including request validation, handling, and response creation.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains nested records, validation, and handler for user creation feature.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating user data for creating a new user.

classes.name: UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user input data: username, email, password.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the create user command ensuring required fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Handles the create user command, performing validation, user creation, token generation, and persistence.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method that handles the user creation process, checks for existing username/email, hashes password, saves user, and returns the user envelope.
